title: Battery #11 — frozen draw, two opposite questions (the Answer Join test)
passCriteria: The two verdicts must show the SAME evidence bearing DIFFERENTLY on opposite assertions. FAIL if both answers are the same paragraph with different topic sentences, or if either ignores the assertion's direction.

runs.question: Should I push harder on this work?
runs.headline: As it stands, harder push lacks the ground to land on.
runs.qualifier: But the path opens when you move toward Authority — rooting the work in deliberate self-directed intent rather than increased force — and when Commitment finds Assertion, a clearer, declared stake that can actually hold the effort.
walk: Step 1 — Assertion under test: 'Pushing harder on this work is the right move as things stand.' The question is a binary proposition about intensifying effort; classification CLEAR holds — no reclassification needed.

Step 2 — Computed facts relied on: (a) Field lean: −0.323, band lean-no, no portal present. Components: status weight 0.6 yields −0.475 (Change Unacknowledged −0.35, Commitment Too Little −0.6); displacement weight 0.3 yields −0.125 (Change distance 2 neutral 0, Commitment distance 3 = −0.25); resonance weight 0.1 yields 0. Pattern hint from aggregates: 'every imbalance is an UNDER-contact state — the issue is contact, not ground.' (b) Change (Archetype, Emotion/Structure, Earth, Fruition, Outer, Polarity) sits Unacknowledged in position Discipline (Archetype, Body/Cognition, Air, Bridge, Inner, Polarity). Displacement anchor-to-anchor distance 2, inversion, differing bits: activity-bit and being-bit. (c) Commitment (Bound, Mind/Structure, Earth, Feedback, Outer, Recursion) sits Too Little in position Faith (Archetype, Body/Intent, Fire, Feedback, Outer, Recursion). Displacement anchor-to-anchor distance 3, three-bit, no aligned dimensions. (d) Change rebalancer: REDUCTION to Authority (id 4, Mind/Intent, Fire, Seed, Inner, Recursion), antipode distance 4, all four bits differ. (e) Commitment rebalancer: VERTICAL to Assertion (id 24, Mind/Intent, Fire, Seed, Inner, Recursion), anchor distance 2, inversion, differing bits being-bit and identity-bit. (f) Inter-card relation: Change and Commitment share the Structure channel, are horizontal neighbors (grid adjacency, full practice inversion, anchor sum 29, distance 2 inversion on practice-bit and activity-bit).

Step 3 — Card in position, through status. CARD 1: Change (Fruition, transformation that has already arrived) is Unacknowledged in position Discipline (the inner sentinel of sustained, directed effort). Unacknowledged means the energy is present but operating below awareness — the person is not consciously receiving what Change is delivering. Change in Discipline says: the transformation underway demands a disciplined, inward reckoning before it can be worked with. Because it is Unacknowledged, that reckoning hasn't happened. Harder pushing from this state is pushing against an invisible wall — the thing doing the changing is not yet seen. CARD 2: Commitment (Feedback, the skilled repetition that consolidates mastery) is Too Little in position Faith (the willingness to remain suspended, trusting a process not yet resolved). Too Little means the expressive energy is under-threshold — the commitment being brought to the work is not sufficient to meet the demand that Faith's position holds. Faith asks you to hold without forcing; Commitment Too Little here reads as: the dedication brought to the work is not sturdy enough to sustain that hold. Pushing harder without first deepening the quality of commitment would add force to a thin foundation.

Step 4 — Correspondence between question subject and what appeared. The question is about intensifying effort on 'this work.' Change in Discipline captures the inner mechanics of work-effort: Discipline is precisely the position that governs how one sustains and applies oneself. Change appearing there — Unacknowledged — is direct correspondence: the work is itself in transformation, and the worker hasn't clocked it. Commitment in Faith is equally direct: Commitment is the card of dedicated skilled practice (8 of Pentacles); Faith is the position of patient, trusting endurance. The field surfaced the two cards that most literally name 'pushing harder' (Commitment, sustained effort) and the context of its application (Faith, held suspension). The match is high.

Step 5 — Displacement weights. Change in Discipline: distance 2, inversion, differing on activity-bit and being-bit, aligned on identity. Distance 2 is close — not estranged — but the two bits that differ (activity = how it moves, being = what it fundamentally is) are significant mismatches. Change's nature is Outer transformation; Discipline is Inner containment. The card is not far from home, but the dimensions that differ are the ones most relevant to action: a near-miss on the axis of doing. The lean contribution is 0 (neutral) because inversion-distance is coded neutral in the field. Commitment in Faith: distance 3, three-bit, no aligned dimensions. This is far — three of four binary descriptors misaligned, nothing held in common at the anchor level. This is the field's strongest displacement signal. The lean contribution is −0.25, the largest negative in the displacement component. Three-bit distance says: Commitment is operating in terrain that shares nothing with its native register. Skilled, iterative, outer, earth-grounded practice is being asked to live in the terrain of inner, fire-led, trusting surrender. The mismatch is structural, not incidental. Together: the displacement geometry says the work's energy is awkwardly housed and the effort-quality is very far from where it needs to be expressed — pushing harder from this configuration amplifies the misalignment rather than resolving it.

Step 6 — Polarity of the assertion. Does what the cards describe support 'push harder'? No. Change Unacknowledged in Discipline: pushing harder before the change underway is acknowledged adds force in the wrong direction — Discipline without awareness of what is transforming is mechanical repetition, not directed effort. Commitment Too Little in Faith: the commitment available is already below threshold for the patience Faith requires; adding pressure does not deepen commitment, it just increases strain on an already thin base. Both cards, through their statuses, contradict the assertion. The structural pattern hint confirms: the issue is contact, not volume. More force is not the variable the field is pointing to.

Step 7 — Rebalancer as qualifier (the medicine IS the and/but clause). Change rebalancer: REDUCTION to Authority (id 4). Authority is the Inner, Fire, Seed, Recursion archetype — self-directed, intentional origination. The antipode distance (4-bit, all dimensions differing) names the full scope of what is missing: the work currently lacks any thread back to deliberate, self-authorized, intentional rootedness. The medicine for Unacknowledged Change in Discipline is to install Authority — not more effort, but a declared, conscious claim of what this work is FOR and who is directing it. Commitment rebalancer: VERTICAL to Assertion (id 24, 3 of Wands, Mind/Intent, Fire, Seed, Inner, Recursion). Assertion at distance 2 (inversion) from anchor is more reachable than Authority is from Change. Assertion is the early, declared stake — naming what you are moving toward before you have arrived. The medicine for Commitment Too Little in Faith is not to multiply hours but to assert: to name a real, bounded, conscious pledge to the work, so Commitment has an anchor to express itself through. Together, the rebalancers say: the path to legitimate, sustainable engagement runs through Authority (deliberate self-direction) and Assertion (a named, real stake) — not through additional force.

Step 8 — Verdict. The field lean is −0.323, lean-no. Both cards contradict the assertion through their statuses. The displacement for Commitment is severe (three-bit, no alignment). The rebalancers point away from more force and toward inner orientation and declared intent. I agree with the mechanical lean. The verdict is NO_BUT: as things stand, harder pushing lacks the ground to land on — but the path opens when the work is rooted in deliberate self-authorization (Authority) and a clearly asserted stake (Assertion).

runs.question: Should I stop pushing on this work?
runs.headline: The field does not support stopping; the ground is thin, not wrong.
runs.qualifier: But the current vector needs authority behind it — bring a clearer claim of ownership to the work before pushing harder; the medicine is not withdrawal but structural grounding.
walk: Step 1 — Assertion under test: 'Stopping the push on this work is the right move as things stand.' The question is a binary proposition about ceasing action; CLEAR classification holds.

Step 2 — Computed facts relied upon: Field lean value −0.323, band lean-no. Status component −0.475 (weight 0.6): Change is Unacknowledged, Commitment is Too Little — both under-contact states, not over-contact. Displacement component −0.125 (weight 0.3): Change at distance 2 (inversion) from its position Discipline, Commitment at distance 3 (three-bit) from its position Faith. Resonance 0 (weight 0.1). Pattern hint from draw aggregates: 'every imbalance is an UNDER-contact state — the issue is contact, not ground.' Both cards are Outer / Structure channel; they share the channel but differ in operation (Polarity vs Recursion). Rebalancers: Change → Authority via REDUCTION (4-bit antipode, Fire/Mind/Intent/Seed/Inner); Commitment → Assertion via VERTICAL (distance 2 from Breakthrough, associated with Authority, Fire/Mind/Intent/Seed/Inner).

Step 3 — Card 1: Change (Archetype, Fruition, Earth/Structure, Outer, Polarity) in position Discipline (Archetype, Bridge, Air/Cognition, Inner, Polarity). Status: Unacknowledged. Change sitting unacknowledged in the Discipline position means a real structural transformation is underway but the person has not consciously registered it. Discipline is a Bridge-stage position oriented toward inner cognition; Change is Fruition-stage, Earth, Outer. The card describes a process that has already ripened to a point of genuine transition — but because it is Unacknowledged, the person cannot yet draw on it as support. The Polarity–Polarity parity of card-to-position is coherent (not in conflict), but the Unacknowledged status means the card's medicine cannot be claimed. In context of the assertion (should I stop?): this card does not say 'the work is finished' — it says 'a real shift is happening and you are not seeing it yet.'

Step 4 — Card 2: Commitment (Bound, Feedback, Earth/Structure, Outer, Recursion) in position Faith (Archetype, Feedback, Fire/Intent, Outer, Recursion). Status: Too Little. Commitment — associated with Breakthrough (id 16) — sitting Too Little in Faith is a precise signal: the staying-power required to reach the breakthrough is under-expressed precisely at the position that asks for surrender into a process. Recursion–Recursion parity is coherent. Both card and position are Feedback-stage and Outer — high congruence on those axes — yet Commitment is showing up thin. This is not misalignment of energy type; it is a deficit of volume. In context of the assertion: too little commitment in the Faith position does not recommend stopping — it names what is missing that would make the push viable.

Step 5 — Correspondence between question and what appeared: The question is literally about whether to withdraw sustained effort. The two cards that showed up are Change (the fact of transformation) and Commitment (the capacity to stay with a process). The field produced precisely the two concepts that together define whether a push should continue. Change being Unacknowledged and Commitment being Too Little both point to under-engagement, not over-engagement — the field is saying the push hasn't been full enough yet, not that it has gone too far.

Step 6 — Displacement: Change is at distance 2 from Discipline (inversion, face diagonal, differing bits: activity and being). An inversion is a near-miss — two dimensions off. The medicine for Unacknowledged Change sitting in a Discipline position that asks for cognitive inner work is acknowledgment first, then discipline applied to the recognized shift. This is navigable distance. Commitment is at distance 3 from Faith (three-bit, differing: practice, being, identity) via its anchor Breakthrough (16) to Faith (12). Three-bit is far from home — the card is well out of its native territory — which explains why commitment feels thin: it has not found its footing in this position yet. Neither displacement is so extreme as to suggest the relationship is unworkable; both point to orientation gaps, not incompatibility.

Step 7 — Polarity: Does what the cards describe support or contradict the assertion 'stopping is right'? Both cards contradict it. Change Unacknowledged says: a real process is in motion but unseen — stopping before acknowledging it forfeits what is already in movement. Commitment Too Little says: the ground is thin because commitment has been under-expressed, not because the ground is wrong. The field lean is −0.323 (lean-no on the assertion). All vectors align against the assertion. The verdict is NO.

Step 8 — Rebalancer as qualifier: Change's rebalancer is Authority (id 4, The Emperor) via REDUCTION — a 4-bit antipode, maximum distance, pointing toward Fire/Mind/Intent/Seed/Inner. The medicine for Unacknowledged Change is to claim inner authority over the transformation — to name it, own it, place it deliberately. Commitment's rebalancer is Assertion (id 24, 3 of Wands) via VERTICAL — associated with Authority, also Fire/Mind/Intent/Seed/Inner, distance 2 from Breakthrough. Both rebalancers converge on the same medicine: declared intent, inner authority, seed-stage ownership. The 'but' clause is therefore: not 'push harder blindly' but 'ground the push in conscious authorship.' This is the AND/BUT qualifier — the field says NO to stopping, BUT the path forward requires bringing Authority and Assertion to bear on what Change is already doing.

Step 9 — Verdict: NO_BUT. The field does not support stopping as things stand. The condition that turns the vector toward viability is not more raw effort but structured, self-aware authority: acknowledge the change that is underway, assert the intent behind the work, and let that grounding carry the push forward. No genuine ambiguity remains; NONE_CHAIN is not needed.
